gazette.name: Free China Gazette
gazette.owner: Publishes from outside the mainland. Funding sources not disclosed.
gazette.funding: Diaspora donations and unnamed foundations. Accounts are not published.
gazette.corrections: No corrections log. Prior claims are quietly removed rather than retracted.
gazette.policy: No published standards. Prints eyewitness accounts without independent verification.
gazette.tell: Everything it reports about state repression tends to be broadly true. Everything it reports about causes and meaning is speculation printed as fact. It cannot tell the difference between the two, and neither can most readers.

ninefold.name: The Ninefold Register
ninefold.founded: Claims 1604. Continuous publication cannot be verified.
ninefold.corrections: Does not issue corrections. Holds that a reading later shown to be wrong was a reading of a different sign.
ninefold.policy: Publishes portents, historical precedent and interpretation. Does not claim to report news and does not pretend to.
ninefold.tell: The only outlet here that is honest about what it is. It tells you it is interpreting rather than reporting. That makes it less dangerous than a newspaper doing the same thing while calling it journalism.

bulletin.name: Henan Provincial Bulletin
bulletin.policy: Publishes provincial notices and technical advisories. Subject to central guidance but drafted locally.
bulletin.tell: Written by people who have to live in the affected province, and it shows. Consistently more specific and more technical than the central ministry, and occasionally says things the centre would rather it did not. Where it and Voice of Order differ, the gap is the story.

voice.name: Voice of Order
voice.corrections: No public corrections log. Stories are silently updated in place.
voice.policy: Editorial guidance issued daily by the Ministry. Publishing outside guidance is a criminal offence.
voice.tell: Its denials are technically precise, which is what makes them useful. Read what it specifically denies and you learn what it has been asked about. Read what it threatens people for saying and you learn what it fears is true.

tws.name: Trident Wire Service
tws.owner: Non-profit member cooperative of 340 subscriber newspapers
tws.funding: Subscriber fees. No single member holds more than 2% of voting stock.
tws.corrections: Public corrections log. 41 corrections issued in the last 12 months, average 3.1 hours after publication.
tws.policy: Two-source rule for all breaking claims. Anonymous sources require editor sign-off and a stated reason for anonymity.
tws.tell: The only outlet here that will tell you it does not know something. Slow, hedged, frequently dull. Its dullness is the product of a process the other two do not have.

kestrel.name: @kestrel_obs
kestrel.owner: Anonymous. Claims a background in remote sensing.
kestrel.corrections: Corrects openly and quickly in-thread. Also deletes posts without note.
kestrel.policy: Publishes raw satellite and hydrology data and lets readers argue. No editor.
kestrel.tell: Frequently first and frequently right on technical detail. Also the origin of two of the worst rumours of the last month. Trust the data, not the conclusions.

lotus.name: WHITE LOTUS
lotus.corrections: Has never issued one. Has never needed to.
lotus.tell: Appears on this desk without a submission record. The technical team has not been able to explain how.
